_about: OBEX Dune-oracle results from reference/obex_monthly_pnl.sql, refreshed via Dune MCP on 2026-06-09 (query 7682762). Refresh added vat.grab events alongside vat.frob in the debt-events sum — ALLOCATOR-OBEX-A has duty = 0 (jug.drip dormant, rate ≡ 1), so the entire stability-fee accrual flows through grab events. Frob-only oracle (captured 2026-04-27 via query 7382870) under-counted cum_debt by the accrued interest.
_methodology_notes: Oracle uses prices.day for syrupUSDC valuation (DEX VWAP). Our pipeline uses convertToAssets (canonical NAV) — accounts for the documented ~$220K prime_agent_revenue diff.
Oracle includes vat.grab events alongside vat.frob in the cum_debt sum (refreshed 2026-06-09). Matches our pipeline's frob+grab base.

Oracle hardcodes BR step-change dates (2025-11-07, 2025-11-11, 2025-12-02, 2025-12-16, 2026-03-09); our pipeline reads SSR from a live data source. Small residual diff (~3% on sky_revenue) acknowledged as methodology drift on the BR-source.
Both pipelines use APY with per-second compounding (POWER((1 + apy), 1/365) - 1).
